data.one_liner: Bluetooth LE plugin for Flutter with background support and automatic reconnect
data.what_it_does: Provides scanning, connecting, GATT operations, notifications, and background mode with queued operations and typed errors.
use_when: Wearable or healthcare apps needing continuous BLE data
Apps that must stay connected in background
Projects requiring automatic reconnect and operation queuing
avoid_when: Simple BLE demos without background needs
Apps that only need one-time reads/writes
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions (BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, etc.) and iOS Info.plist keys (NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription, UIBackgroundModes). Set minSdk to 24. No build_runner needed.
